tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App background and screen base.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Grouped list backgrounds, input fills, section bands. Matches the logo's off-white ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and menus that sit above surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers only. Not for control borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox and outline-button borders; meets 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-subtle, surface-raised and brand-tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, helper text, timestamps, on surface and surface-subtle.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary blue from the logo bubble. Primary buttons, active tabs, selected states, links. As text on surface or surface-subtle.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Deep blue from the logo wordmark. Pressed state, brand headings, link text on brand-tint.

tokens.name: brand-accent
tokens.usage: Light blue from the logo's bubble tail. Decorative highlights, illustrations, charts. Never for text.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds: selected list rows, info alerts, brand badges.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand or brand-strong fill (the primary button label).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive status text and icons, always with a check icon or a word, on surface or success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success alerts and badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution status text and icons, always with an icon or word, on surface or warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning alerts and badges.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions, always with an icon or word, on surface or danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error alerts and badges.

tokens.name: rating
tokens.usage: Filled rating stars only (non-text graphic). Empty stars use line-strong.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px, on every surface.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links; alias of brand.

families.sans: "Figtree", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

groups.name: Headings
groups.note: Lexend: geometric and rounded like the reviewdat wordmark. Headings only.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Onboarding and empty-state hero lines. One per screen at most.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Card titles and list item titles.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Figtree: friendly, very readable at small sizes.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Leave feedback so the team can move forward.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary text, list subtitles, helper text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges, timestamps, chart labels. Never for paragraphs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a component.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between related items, list item padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margins, card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large section spacing, top of screens.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Empty states and onboarding.

radius.note: Rounded and friendly, echoing the logo's speech bubble.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, small chips, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, alerts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the app icon shape.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, tab indicators.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, menus, toasts.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs: meets the 44–48px touch-target minimum.

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons inside cards.

tokens.name: icon-size
tokens.usage: Default icon size.
